capabilities: Merge notes and folders with frontmatter and attachments
Extract selections, headings, or cursor ranges into notes
Split notes by heading level or horizontal rules into folder trees
Bulk rename notes and folders with find and replace and numbering
Flatten, move, reorder, and swap files and folders
extras: Documentation is an interactive demo vault; beta releases install via BRAT. Bulk operations can optionally be recorded as individual git commits on desktop.
intentEvidence: This Obsidian plugin fixes those, and then goes considerably further
motivation: To fix the core Note composer's broken relative links, rejected headings, and fixed append target, and to add folder-wide operations.
problem: Obsidian's core Note composer breaks relative links, rejects headings with invalid filename characters, and always appends extracted text instead of letting you choose where it goes.

relations.evidence: Overlaps on folder merging; subfolders become headings; the result stays a vault note
Broader editing scope: also merges, swaps and moves notes, folders and selections
Alternative splitting: headings; optional recursive folder tree
Merges also preserve keys from Permanent Links when it is enabled

summary: Note and folder toolkit that merges, splits, extracts, reorders, and bulk-renames notes and folders with link and frontmatter handling.
